from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    category: Literal['行政行为 - 行政给付', '行政行为 - 行政确认', '适用特殊程序案件案由', '知识产权与竞争纠纷', '行政行为 - 行政监督', '婚姻家庭纠纷', '人格权纠纷'] | None = Field(description="The assigned case cause category from the 7 specified in the task")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
